title: Release Bundle Manifest v1
description: Canonical manifest produced by scripts/package_release.py for each release bundle build. Records git metadata, environment, artifacts, checksums, signing status, and structured evidence.

bundle_id.description: Stable identifier for this bundle build (e.g., rig-relay-acp-darwin-arm64-abc1234).

bundle_name.description: Human-readable name for this bundle configuration.

bundle_format.description: PyInstaller bundle format. onedir for a directory bundle, onefile for a single executable, native for non-PyInstaller packaging.

git_commit_sha.description: Full 40-character git commit SHA at build time.

git_dirty.description: True if the working tree had uncommitted changes at build time.

official_release.description: True only for GitHub Actions runs triggered by a release event. False for all other cases including codespaces.

pyinstaller_version.description: PyInstaller version string, or null if unavailable.

uv_version.description: uv version string, or null if unavailable.

spec_files.description: PyInstaller spec files used in this build.

path.description: Relative path from output directory to the artifact.

kind.description: Artifact kind (e.g., executable, checksum, manifest, evidence, placeholder).

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the artifact.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings encountered during the build.

errors.description: Fatal errors encountered during the build.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of this manifest file (filled in after write).

checksums_path.description: Relative path to the SHA256SUMS file.

evidence_jsonl_path.description: Relative path to the evidence JSONL file.

telemetry_redaction_notes.description: Statement that no raw prompts, secrets, credentials, or private files were emitted in this manifest.
